title: Complete endpoints baseline contract and direct AutoPilot schema bundle entrypoint

phases.objective: Make endpoints migration pre-use columns explicit in the canonical baseline and make direct Start-AutoPilot schema bundle flags fail-closed and schema-only.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The generator runs from an exact clean main checkout with explicit BUILD_STAGING_SCHEMA_BUNDLE confirmation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Migration 023 can add schema import tracking columns after the canonical endpoints baseline without unknown-column failure.
steps: Read required_endpoints_baseline_columns from the role manifest.
Validate every required endpoints column in schema.sql before disposable MariaDB starts.
Apply baseline and ordered migrations only after endpoints preflight passes.
Keep the schema bundle three-role, schema-only, exact-SHA, and free of Production/provider access.
assertions: The canonical endpoints baseline includes child_openai_schema_file_id before migration 023.
The generator emits required_endpoints_baseline_columns in plan evidence.
An incomplete endpoints contract fails before disposable MariaDB execution.
production_accessed is false and provider_accessed is false.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The direct entrypoint validates or applies the three-role schema-only bundle through Clone-StagingDatabases before certification and never accesses Production.
steps: Require all three role bundle files when either schema flag is set.
Invoke Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1 in schema_only mode with the exact expected commit.
Apply only when ApplySchemaBundle is explicitly set; otherwise perform dry-run validation.
Persist schema seed status in AutoPilot state and continue same-cycle certification.
assertions: Missing bundle is fail-closed when RequireSchemaBundle or ApplySchemaBundle is set.
The direct entrypoint uses schema_only mode and explicit local apply semantics.
